text:
Priya: incident-bot flagged a P99/P99.9 latency cliff in us-west-2 around paging + KV cache growth. Continuous batching looks to be coalescing large batches -> memory pressure -> eviction storms. Customers seeing latency jumps and a few 5xx. I’m starting triage, taking initial ownership.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 2150001111 - KV cache paging rate x12, blockmgr eviction rate spike, continuous-batch queue depth high. Severity: high. Links: https://metrics.redwood/alerts/2150001111 :rotating_light:

Sam: grabbing metrics and the block manager logs now. can someone dump the batch config for hosted-prod-usw2? suspect recent batch threshold change.

Ava: I see the batch knobs from config service: max_batch_tokens=4096, max_batch_items=128, batch_timeout_ms=50. pushing an emergency tuning: reduce max_batch_tokens -> 2048 and max_batch_items -> 48 to lower pressure. Applying to pool group 'hosted-prod-usw2' (canary first).

Ava: POSTing API change:
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/pools/hosted-prod-usw2/config" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"max_batch_tokens":2048,"max_batch_items":48}'
```

deploy-bot: config-update accepted, rollout started for pool hosted-prod-usw2 (canary nodes: host-03, host-07). change-id: cfg-2150001111-evict-tune

Jorge: I'm seeing the block metadata counter spike in blockmgr logs — metadata_refs_count jumped 497k -> 1.2M after the burst. starting a canary patch to add metadata backoff and avoid cascade eviction amplification. will push to 3 nodes and watch.

Priya: customer-impact snapshot: AcmeCorp and Datafy showed 5xx and >8s latency for a ~7 minute window. TelecomMetrics hit 12s tail. CS notified. Sam, please collect request ids for affected customers so support can correlate.

Sam: grabbing request ids via trace index (querying traces for host tags and 5xx between 2150001000-2150001400). pushing list to the incident ticket.

Ava: canary results: after lowering batch knobs paging rate dropped ~40% in canary within 3 minutes, heap pressure decreased. rolling change to remaining nodes in-USW2.

Ava: applying global CLI just in case:
```
redwood-admin set-pool-config --pool hosted-prod-usw2 --max-batch-tokens 2048 --max-batch-items 48 --reason "incident mitigation 2150001111"
```

metrics-bot: KV paging_rate/usw2 decreased from 1200/s -> 720/s in 3m after change. eviction_rate down 55%.

Jorge: pushed small patch to blockmgr to throttle metadata-heavy evictions and limit per-block eviction concurrency. Command run on canary nodes:
```
kubectl apply -f patch-blockmgr-eviction-backoff.yaml
```
Logs show backpressure smoothing out.

Priya: On-call handoff: I’ll hand to Sam for the next 2 hours while I coordinate CS & postmortem framing. Sam — you own live mitigation and escalation to eng-runtime if this resurfaces. @Sam take? :handshake:

Sam: taking it. I'll keep a 30m loop: if tail doesn't approach baseline, escalate to runtime/infra for rollback of recent autotune. Also will validate prefix-KV cache integrity and run leak-scan.

Priya: note — we observed a metadata-leak-like counter tick concurrent with the batch spike. Please run the leak hunter and upload heap profiles. Run:
```
/run/leak-hunt.sh --target host-07 --duration 120 --out s3://redwood-debug/2150001111/
```

Jorge: heap/profile artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-debug/2150001111/heap-host-03.tgz, heap-host-07.tgz. Also pushing parsed report to the ticket.

Sam: intermediate status: after full rollout of batch knob changes + blockmgr backoff, P95 back within SLOs; P99 still ~1.8-2x for a subset of requests. paging rate stable but not fully back to baseline. I’m enabling a temporary KV prefix cache eviction-softlimit to prevent metadata amplification.

Ava: created incident tracker INC-4421 with preliminary notes and customer-impact list. Notifying support team and CS.

support-bot: Support notified. Ticket INC-4421 linked to customer cases: ACME-834, DATAFY-291, TELE-502.

Sam: next steps: 1) run deeper heap analysis to confirm no persistent leak 2) check continuous-batch algorithm telemetry (recent autotune candidate?) 3) schedule RCA with eng-runtime + eng-sre, include eval set to reproduce paging scenario 4) consider reverting autotune if we find correlation.

Priya: thanks all. For now mitigations in place: reduced batch knobs, blockmgr eviction backoff, temporary prefix eviction limit. Sam owns until 2150004711 (handoff time). I’ll draft initial incident summary and collect logs for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

metrics-bot: alert cleared at 2150003200 for eviction storm, paging rate still elevated but trending down.

Sam: will update thread with timeline and final status once stable. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre for RCA.

Priya: adding a reminder — check recent commits to continuous-batcher autotuner from the last release window; tagging @Jorge for correlation with blockmgr changes.

Jorge: noted. saving repro harness and scheduling a local replay against canary config.

Priya: closing live mitigation phase in this thread. Postmortem TODOs assigned in INC-4421.

--- End of thread (actions: config rollouts, canary patch, heap uploads, support notification).
